title: nymphaea alba subsp. minoriflora
intro: Nymphaea alba subsp. minoriflora, commonly known as White Water Lily, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Nymphaeaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Nymphaea alba subsp. minoriflora include sedative and anti-anxiety effects, which may help to promote relaxation and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
